arguments.sql:
SELECT
    g.XCL_006 AS Country,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.XCL_007 = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(g.XCL_004) AS PercentagePremium
FROM gasstations AS g
WHERE g.XCL_004 IN (
    SELECT t.XCL_015
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON t.XCL_013 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE ym.XCL_020 = '201306'
)
GROUP BY g.XCL_006

SELECT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0" AS Country, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_2" = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT("__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_1") AS PercentagePremium FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g.XCL_006 AS "__grain_value_0", g.XCL_004 AS "__grain_value_1", g.XCL_007 AS "__grain_value_2" FROM gasstations AS g WHERE g.XCL_004 IN (SELECT t.XCL_015 FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON t.XCL_013 = ym.XCL_019 WHERE ym.XCL_020 = '201306')) AS __ontology_entity_grain GROUP BY "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0"

    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.XCL_007 = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(g.XCL_004) AS PercentagePremium
